name: @dreamfactory/engine
description: The CyberFlix DreamFactory engine, reimplemented — container formats (df/) and the runtime that plays them (runtime/). Knows about no particular game.
//: Raw TypeScript, deliberately: every consumer is bundled by Vite or run by tsx/vitest, so there is no build step to keep in sync and no dist/ to go stale. The wildcard means `@dreamfactory/engine/df/set` reads `engine/src/df/set.ts`.
